intro: Grell Earrings are crude baubles scavenged and worn by the feral creatures infesting the ruins of Bashal'Aran. Though unremarkable at a glance, their proximity to ancient relics allows sensitive spirits to trace the lingering magical seals holding them in torment.

p: The Wild Grells and Vile Sprites lurking around the collapsed marble of Bashal'Aran hoard assorted trinkets, frequently fashioning earrings from scraps they scavenge among the ruins. To most mortals, these items are worthless refuse. However, to Asterion, an ancient night elf bound as a tormented phantom within the ruins, they serve as dowsing implements. By scrutinizing the resonant magical traces absorbed by these earrings, Asterion attempts to locate the ancient seal that imprisons his spectral form.
